app.name: FinPilot AI
app.disclaimer: Educational project. FinPilot AI does not execute trades and never promises an investment return.
app.demo_banner: Demo mode — every series below is a reproducible simulation, not a market observation.
app.historical_banner: Historical data mode — prices come from the configured providers and are shown as delivered.
app.footer: FinPilot AI v{version} · educational use only · no investment advice
app.no_api_key: No AI provider configured — everything else works normally.
sidebar.help_body:
1. Pick a market, a data mode and a period.
2. Build your portfolio and set the weights.
3. Explore performance, risk, optimisation and stress tests.
4. Ask the assistant to explain the computed results.
mode.demo.help: Offline, reproducible synthetic series, clearly labelled as simulated.
mode.historical.help: Real historical prices from the configured provider (yfinance for the US, CSV import for Morocco).
mode.label: Mode
market.help: The market determines the instrument universe, the trading calendar and the reporting currency.
common.name: Name
kpi.initial_capital.help: Amount invested at the beginning of the analysed period.
kpi.current_value.help: Initial capital compounded by the portfolio's daily returns over the period.
kpi.gain_loss.help: Difference between the current value and the initial capital.
kpi.cumulative_return.help: Compound return over the whole period: product of (1 + daily return) minus 1.
kpi.annualized_return.help: Geometric annualisation of the cumulative return using 252 trading days per year.
kpi.annualized_volatility.help: Standard deviation of daily returns multiplied by √252 — a measure of dispersion, not of loss.
kpi.sharpe_ratio.help: Annualised excess return (return − risk-free rate) divided by annualised volatility. Undefined when volatility is zero.
kpi.sortino_ratio.help: Annualised excess return divided by downside deviation (only negative deviations are penalised).
kpi.max_drawdown.help: Largest peak-to-trough decline of the portfolio value, computed from the wealth index and its running maximum.
kpi.var_95.help: Historical loss threshold exceeded on the worst 5% of the observed days.
kpi.cvar_95.help: Average loss on the days beyond the 95% Value at Risk (historical, non-parametric).
kpi.beta.help: Sensitivity of the portfolio to the benchmark: 1.0 means the portfolio moved like the benchmark.
kpi.alpha.help: Annualised excess return not explained by the benchmark exposure (CAPM alpha, historical estimate).
kpi.tracking_error.help: Annualised standard deviation of the difference between the portfolio and the benchmark returns.
kpi.information_ratio.help: Active annualised return divided by the tracking error.
kpi.correlation_benchmark.help: Pearson correlation between the portfolio and the benchmark daily returns.
kpi.benchmark_return.help: Annualised return of the benchmark over the same aligned period.
kpi.excess_return.help: Portfolio annualised return minus benchmark annualised return.
kpi.concentration_hhi.help: Sum of squared weights: 1.0 means a single asset, lower is more diversified.
kpi.effective_assets.help: 1 / HHI — the number of equally weighted assets that would give the same concentration.
kpi.diversification_ratio.help: Weighted average volatility divided by portfolio volatility. 1.0 means no diversification benefit.
kpi.top3_weight.help: Combined weight of the three largest holdings.
kpi.average_correlation.help: Mean of the pairwise correlations between the assets held.
kpi.observations.help: Number of aligned daily observations used by the calculations.
kpi.best_day.help: Highest daily return observed in the period.
kpi.worst_day.help: Lowest daily return observed in the period.
kpi.positive_days.help: Share of days with a positive return.
kpi.assets_count.help: Number of assets with a usable history in the portfolio.
kpi.expected_return.help: Annualised mean of the historical returns of this allocation (in-sample estimate).
kpi.volatility.help: Annualised volatility implied by the historical covariance matrix and the weights.
kpi.risk_free_rate.help: Annualised rate used in the Sharpe and Sortino ratios (configurable in Settings).
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Portfolio value, performance, risk and data quality at a glance.
dashboard.allocation_subtitle: Weight of each holding in the portfolio.
dashboard.performance_subtitle: Portfolio value and cumulative return over the period.
dashboard.benchmark_missing: No benchmark series available for this period.
dashboard.currency_split_help: Currencies are never mixed without an explicit exchange rate.
dashboard.empty_body: Load the default portfolio or build your own in the Portfolio Builder.
dashboard.no_data_body: The selected portfolio could not be analysed with the current data. Check the messages below or switch to demo mode.
builder.title: Portfolio Builder
builder.subtitle: Choose the instruments, set the weights and validate the allocation.
builder.capital_help: Amount allocated to this portfolio at the start of the period. Used for monetary values only; returns and risk are unaffected.
builder.benchmark_help: Reference series used for the relative performance metrics.
builder.period_warning: The start date must be before the end date.
builder.saved: Portfolio saved — every page now uses these settings.
builder.empty_selection: Select at least one instrument to build a portfolio.
builder.morocco_note: FinPilot AI does not provide Casablanca Stock Exchange quotes. Import your own verified data through CSV files (or configure data/morocco_universe.json), or use demo mode.
builder.us_note: US prices are downloaded from yfinance when you are online; without a connection, switch to demo mode.
builder.demo_note: Demo mode uses fictional instruments (DEMO-…) and reproducible simulated series.
builder.csv_help: Accepted layouts: long (date, symbol, close) or wide (date, SYMBOL_A, SYMBOL_B). Semicolon-separated and Latin-1 files are supported.
builder.preset_apply: Load the default portfolio for this market and mode
builder.currency_single: All holdings are denominated in {currency} — a single total is reported.
builder.currency_mixed: This portfolio holds several currencies ({currencies}). Totals are reported per currency; no combined total is produced without an explicit exchange rate.
builder.allow_multi_currency_help: Off by default: mixing USD and MAD requires you to acknowledge the separate reporting.
perf.title: Performance Analytics
perf.subtitle: Return decomposition, benchmark comparison and rolling statistics.
perf.rolling_window_invalid: The rolling window must be smaller than the number of observations ({observations}).
perf.drawdown_help: Distance from the historical peak (running maximum) of the portfolio value.
perf.contributions_help: Average weight times average asset return — how each asset contributed to the period return.
perf.insufficient: Not enough observations for the rolling statistics ({available} available).
perf.no_benchmark: Select a benchmark in the Portfolio Builder to unlock the relative metrics.
risk.title: Risk & Diversification
risk.subtitle: Volatility, correlations, concentration and tail risk.
risk.correlation_help: 1.0 means the assets moved together; 0 means no linear relationship. Correlations below 0.4 usually bring diversification.
risk.risk_contribution_help: Marginal contribution to portfolio volatility: w_i · (Σw)_i / σ_p, normalised to 100%.
risk.drawdown_details: The maximum drawdown of {drawdown} ran from {peak} to {trough}{recovery}.
risk.drawdown_recovered: and was recovered on {date} ({days} days later)
risk.drawdown_not_recovered: and had not recovered at the end of the period
risk.var_help: Loss thresholds estimated from the observed daily returns. They describe the past, not a probability of future loss.
risk.warning.high_hhi: The HHI is above 0.25: the portfolio depends on a few positions.
risk.warning.low_effective_n: The effective number of assets is low relative to the number of holdings.
risk.warning.dominant_position: A single position represents more than half of the portfolio.
risk.no_warning: No concentration issue detected with the current weights.
risk.insufficient: At least two assets with overlapping history are required for the correlation analysis.
risk.risk_return: Risk / return profile of the holdings
risk.risk_return_help: Each point is an asset; the size reflects its portfolio weight.
risk.diversification_ratio_help: Above 1.0 the assets do not move perfectly together; the higher, the stronger the diversification benefit.
optimization.title: Portfolio Optimization
optimization.subtitle: Compare your allocation with historical minimum-volatility and maximum-Sharpe allocations.
optimization.method_help: Both objectives are computed in-sample from the historical return matrix.
optimization.max_weight_help: Set a cap to avoid relying on a single asset (1.0 = no cap).
optimization.apply: Apply these weights to my portfolio
optimization.applied: Optimised weights applied to the portfolio.
optimization.caveat: Optimisation is an in-sample exercise: it relies on historical estimates of returns and covariances, which are noisy and unstable. Results depend on the estimation window and the constraints chosen, and they do not guarantee better future performance.
optimization.insufficient: Not enough observations to optimise reliably: {available} available, {required} required.
optimization.not_enough_assets: At least two assets with usable history are required.
optimization.engine_unavailable: No optimisation backend (PyPortfolioOpt or SciPy) is available in this environment.
optimization.no_result: No optimisation has been run yet for this portfolio.
optimization.in_sample_warning: In-sample estimate based on past observations.
stress.title: Stress Testing
stress.subtitle: Apply hypothetical percentage shocks to your holdings and measure the estimated impact.
stress.banner: Hypothetical scenario — not a forecast, not a probability, not a promise.
stress.unaffected_weight: Weight not affected by any shock: {weight}
stress.no_result: Define at least one non-zero shock, then apply the scenario.
ai.title: AI Financial Assistant
ai.subtitle: Explanations of the figures FinPilot AI has already computed — never new numbers.
ai.not_configured_body: Copy .env.example to .env and set LLM_API_KEY (plus LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_MODEL for a non-OpenAI provider). Every other page keeps working without a key.
ai.quick.correlation: Explain the correlations between my assets
ai.quick.optimization: Compare my allocation with the optimised one
ai.quick.summary: Give me a complete portfolio review
ai.input_placeholder: Ask a question about your portfolio…
ai.context_body: Only the figures computed by FinPilot AI are transmitted. The model never calculates authoritative financial numbers.
ai.disclaimer: The assistant explains computed results. It is not a financial adviser and cannot guarantee any outcome.
ai.needs_portfolio: A portfolio with usable data is required before asking questions.
ai.use_context_help: The structured metrics, correlations, optimisation and stress-test results are attached to every question.
ai.error_not_configured: The assistant is not configured (missing API key).
ai.error_timeout: The AI provider did not answer in time ({seconds}s). Try again or increase LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
ai.error_http: The AI provider returned an error (HTTP {status}): {detail}
ai.error_network: The AI provider could not be reached: {detail}
ai.error_empty: The AI provider returned an empty answer.
ai.error_unexpected: Unexpected error while contacting the AI provider: {detail}
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Language, financial assumptions, data sources, AI configuration and maintenance.
settings.risk_free_rate_help: Used by the Sharpe and Sortino ratios and by the maximum-Sharpe optimisation. Expressed as a decimal (0.03 = 3%).
settings.demo_seed_help: Changing the seed regenerates a different — but still reproducible — simulated history.
settings.min_coverage_help: An asset missing more than this share of the observations is excluded from the alignment.
settings.fx_rate_help: FinPilot AI never guesses exchange rates. Set FP_FX_RATE_USDMAD in .env to declare one explicitly (it is then displayed with its date and source).
settings.fx_missing: No exchange rate configured — monetary totals are reported separately per currency.
settings.provider_us: US equities & ETFs: yfinance (requires an Internet connection).
settings.provider_ma: Morocco: CSV import or a user-provided universe file. No Casablanca Stock Exchange symbol is shipped with the app.
settings.provider_demo: Demo: reproducible simulated series generated locally.
settings.ai_note: Keys are read from environment variables only and are never stored, logged or displayed in full.
settings.diagnostics_body: Runtime information useful for support requests.
settings.about_body: FinPilot AI is an educational portfolio analytics platform covering US and Moroccan markets. It never executes trades and never promises returns.
data.dropped_observations: {count} observations dropped when aligning the assets on common dates.
data.timezone_note: All dates are calendar dates from the provider; US and Moroccan trading calendars differ, so only common dates are used for multi-market portfolios.
data.currency_split_note: Monetary totals are reported per currency because no exchange rate is configured.
charts.normalised_note: Both series are normalised to 100 at the first common date.

notice.demo.business_days_only: Simulated series use business days (Mon–Fri); market holidays are not modelled.

notice.us.no_close_field: Unexpected response format from the provider for {symbols}.

notice.us.benchmark_unavailable: The benchmark {symbol} is unavailable for this period.
notice.us.empty_rows_ignored: {count} rows without any price were ignored.
notice.ma.no_source: No Moroccan data source available: upload CSV files or configure data/morocco_universe.json. FinPilot AI never invents Casablanca Stock Exchange prices.
notice.ma.no_valid_file: None of the provided CSV files could be used.
notice.ma.local_file_missing: The CSV file {file} referenced by the universe file was not found.
notice.ma.merge_failed: The imported files could not be merged: {detail}
notice.ma.no_requested_symbols: None of the portfolio symbols is present in the imported files: {symbols}

notice.csv.future_dates_dropped: {count} rows with a future date were ignored ({file}).
notice.csv.invalid_date_index: The price table is not indexed by dates.
notice.csv.unsorted_dates: The observations are not sorted by date.
notice.csv.rows_without_any_price: {count} rows contain no price at all.
notice.csv.symbol_has_gaps: {symbol} has {missing} missing observations (kept as missing, never filled).
notice.alignment.many_rows_dropped: More than a quarter of the rows were dropped when aligning the assets on common dates.
notice.alignment.short_history: Short history: fewer than {required} observations — treat the metrics as indicative.
notice.data.demo_portfolio_loaded: The default demo portfolio was loaded because the previous assets are not simulated instruments.
notice.data.portfolio_reconciled: The portfolio was adapted to the selected market and data mode.
notice.data.no_assets_for_market: No instrument is currently available for this market and data mode. Import a CSV file, configure the universe file, or switch to demo mode.
notice.stress.no_target: The shock '{key}' does not apply to any asset in the portfolio.

tooltip.simulated: This series is a simulation generated by FinPilot AI, not a market observation.
tooltip.benchmark: Reference series used to compute beta, alpha and the tracking error.
tooltip.risk_free_rate: Annualised rate of a risk-free investment, used as the reference return.
tooltip.observations: Only dates present for every retained asset are used.
tooltip.optimization: Weights computed from the historical covariance matrix; past estimates do not guarantee future results.
tooltip.var: Historical quantile of the observed daily returns.
tooltip.correlation: Pearson correlation on pairwise complete observations.
